reason: I know we give away some work, that's how we keep clients, and I don't need a stranger telling me which goodwill to claw back. Nobody in my peer group has used this, and I'm not handing a one-man startup our PSA export and client contracts to be one of his first ten guinea pigs.
objection: It's an unknown founder with no track record asking for our full ticket history and client contracts. A DPA is just paper if the company folds, and I'd want proof it finds real money rather than a list of things I already chose not to bill.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three owners in my peer group telling me it found real, billable money in their book without upsetting clients, ideally with benchmark numbers I can compare against.
